--- Operations manifest snippet (for procurement) ---
Retention and audit logs:
- Request-level logs retained for 180 days by default; customer can request extended retention as an add-on.
- Audit logs (configuration changes, model rollouts) retained for 24 months.
- Logs stored in a customer-dedicated S3 bucket (if Private) or in encrypted buckets per-region for Hosted accounts; keys managed by Redwood KMS by default; optional customer-managed KMS available for Private deployments.
Access:
- Role-based access control for internal Redwood personnel; customers get read-only access to their request logs via pre-signed URLs or a secure portal.
- All log access is traced; exportable CSV with access timestamps included for audit packets.

Vanessa / Laura — pricing check:

- RU mapping: 1 RU ~ 200k burst-token equivalent under our default throughput assumptions; 1.2M tokens ~= 6 RUs, so the placeholder is fine.
- Proration: For Jun–Dec (7 months) we should calculate 7/12 of annual RU fee. Recommended line items:
  * Reserved throughput (6 RU) — List: $27,000/yr per RU -> prorated Jun–Dec: (6 * 27,000) * 7/12 = $94,500 total (show as prorated line and effective after credits).
  * Implementation credit: -$6,000 (one-time) — proposed by sales to offset transition effort.
  * Effective total (post-credit): $88,500 — show monthly equivalents to help procurement cashflow planning.
- Commercial ask: keep the list price shown and then an "effective pricing" table with the discount and implementation credit so procurement sees both.

I can produce a short pricing table to drop into the change order — will send updated numbers by EOD.
